verdict.rationale: Hold Fairfield North. It is refundable, remains under the stated $190 pre-tax target with parking included, and its included 6:30 breakfast supports the 8:30 workshop starts. The user has repeatedly prioritized early breakfast and coffee plus free parking over saving roughly ten minutes of travel time. B adds paid parking and paid breakfast; C offers only a coffee bar; D is nonrefundable and farther away.
